name: get_available_slots

messages.content: Thanks for your patience, I'm still working on that.

description: Find open appointment times. Only call this once you have a patient_id (SAVED/ALREADY_SAVED/UPDATED/VERIFIED) and the caller wants to book or reschedule an appointment. Returns up to 3 options; offer the caller at most 2 at a time. Times are Eastern.

preferred_date.description: Optional specific date the caller asked for, as MM/DD/YYYY. Omit if they have no specific day in mind.

time_of_day.description: Caller's preferred part of the day. Use 'any' if they have no preference.
